en.content: The total number of ways in which 5 balls of different colours can be distributed among 3 persons so that each person gets at least one ball is
en.explanation:
Here, 5 distinct balls are to be distributed amongst 3 persons so that each gets at least one ball. So, two possible cases arises

Case I : Two of the persons get one-one ball each and the third person gets three balls.

i.e.
A B C
1 1 3

Now, A can get the ball in ways. After that, can get one ball in ways and then after can get three balls in ways.

Hence, Total number of ways

Case II : Two of the persons get two-two balls each and the third person gets one ball.

i.e.
A B C
2 2 1

Now, A can get two balls in ways. After that, can get 2 ball in ways and then after can get 1 ball in way. Hence, total number of ways

Hence, total number of ways to distribute 5 balls

Combination with Repetition

(i) Only two possible cases arises:

Case I :

A B C
1 1 3

Case II:

A B C
2 2 1

(iii) Use the concept of combination to find individual ways and then add up the total ways in each case.
